name: stefangabos/zebra_database
description: An advanced, compact and lightweight MySQL database wrapper library, built around PHP's MySQLi extension.

scripts-descriptions.test-coverage: Runs the test suite and writes an HTML coverage report to tests/coverage-html
scripts-descriptions.check-compat: Checks the library against the supported PHP versions (7.3 and up). ArgumentFunctionsReportCurrentValue is excluded because the two debug_backtrace() calls it flags are only used to read a file name and a line number, never to inspect argument values
scripts-descriptions.check-compat-legacy: Checks the library against PHP 5.5 and up - the versions it still runs on but that are too old to test against. NewClasses is additionally excluded because the only hit is 'catch (Error)', and PHP resolves a catch type only when something is thrown, so on PHP 5 that block is simply never entered
